description:
Set one segment's final prompts VERBATIM — no LLM rewrite. The direct
    counterpart to update_segment_content: your text is written as-is to the
    segment's creative direction and to the matching asset configs the
    renderer reads. Asset statuses are untouched: an already-rendered asset
    stays complete, and generate_segments skips complete assets — so to see
    the edit rendered, call regenerate_segment_asset on that segment (the
    ONLY re-render path after a prompt edit). Continuation links, SFX, and
    overlays are untouched. Pass only the prompt(s) you want to change;
    media_queries edits a fetched segment's stock-search text the same way.

image_prompt.description: New scene-image prompt (image segments; also the retrieval-miss fallback on real-photo segments). Empty leaves it unchanged.
image_prompt.title: Image Prompt

media_queries.description: New stock-search queries for a fetched-media segment (real b-roll / real photo). Replaces the search text verbatim; re-fetch an already-fetched clip with regenerate_segment_asset. Omit to leave the search unchanged.
media_queries.title: Media Queries

project_id.description: Project ID, as returned by create_project or list_projects
project_id.title: Project Id

segment_number.description: 1-based segment number, as reported by get_segments
segment_number.title: Segment Number

start_frame_prompt.description: New start-frame prompt (generated video segments). Empty leaves it unchanged.
start_frame_prompt.title: Start Frame Prompt

video_prompt.description: New motion/video prompt (video segments; also the retrieval-miss fallback on real b-roll). Empty leaves it unchanged.
video_prompt.title: Video Prompt

name: update_segment_prompts
